reference_use.conclusion: Confirmed the pinned project and mathlib revisions and clean tracked sources. BinaryForm is the homogeneous polynomial submodule; IsEichlerIntegral specifies coefficientwise derivatives using linePow. Imported project definitions match the snapshot byte-for-byte. The snapshot supplies iteratedDeriv_succ; searching project Lean files for scalarization_derivative returned no matches. The exact comparator rerun confirmed compatibility and only the permitted transitive axioms propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound.

theorems.name: Submission.p02_es_177ebb5a_scalarization_derivative
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : UpperHalfPlane → ℂ) (E : UpperHalfPlane → ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)), DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z : ℂ => h (UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex z)) {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im} → HeckeEis.IsEichlerIntegral n h E → ∀ τ : UpperHalfPlane, iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (fun z : ℂ => MvPolynomial.eval (fun j : Fin 2 => if j = 0 then 1 else -z) (E (UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex z)).val) (τ : ℂ) = ((-1 : ℂ) ^ n * (Nat.factorial n : ℂ)) * h τ
theorems.natural_summary: Combines the previously accepted jet recurrence and open-set derivative ladder to obtain the stated scalarization derivative.
